verdict_reason: Functionally harmless, but the organisation header is sent to the admin outbox-events route the backend exempts, which misstates which routes are organisation-scoped.

todos.issue: confirmEventArrival now sends traderOrganisationHeaders() to GET /notifications/{ref}/outbox-events (lines 149-152), and readBody gained a headers parameter (line 50) only for this call. That route is an admin route the ticket puts out of scope and the backend exempts from the header (TraderOrganisationHeaderFilter.shouldNotFilter: 'GET' + '/notifications/[^/]+/outbox-events' returns true; class Javadoc: 'Admin routes (... outbox-event listing) are excluded'). The helper's own JSDoc says it is for 'trader notification API calls'. The call tells the next reader the outbox listing is organisation-scoped when it is not, and the header has no effect on the result.
todos.fix: Must: the perf test sends the organisation header only to routes the backend scopes by organisation, so the code states the same rule as TraderOrganisationHeaderFilter; readBody carries no parameter that no caller needs. One way: drop the traderOrganisationHeaders() argument and the import from eventing.js, and revert readBody to readBody(url).
